text:
Sam: Heads up — saw a latency spike on private us-west2 between ~01:12-01:15 UTC. 99th jumped from ~120ms to ~620ms, p95 also rose. No deploys in that window.

Jess: Thanks, Sam. Any correlation with traffic or model changes?

Sam: Traffic steady. Small increase in long-running streams. Saw concurrent rise in egress TX queue lengths on the VPC NAT node.

Rachel: linking perf dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/services/rlsp/egress-q | queueing heatmaps show pronounced tail at that time.

Teo: Ran a quick kernel/prof sample on the serving host. Notable spike in time spent in softirq and sk_buff transmit path. Looks like packets were being fragmented/queued -> fallback path in the networking kernel.

infra-bot: NAT node conntrack: peak 98% of configured table, conntrack drops=12, NAT SNAT collisions=0.

Sam: Interesting. We also rolled the KV-cache batching heuristic change yesterday (kv-batch-size auto-up from 4->8 on high-latency signals). That increases per-request aggregated size. Could be pushing MTU/segmentation behavior over the egress path.

Jess: @Teo can you paste the perf stack?

Teo: Sure — trimmed: 
```
softirq/0x2:  48%  network  [kernel]
  __netdev_alloc_skb+0x1a
  napi_gro_receive+0x4f
  skb_put+0x8
  ip_finish_output2+0x3c
  ip_route_output_key+0x88
  __ip_append_data+0x1d
```
Looks like heavy skb allocation and GRO/segmentation work.

Rachel: On the NAT side, tc qdisc backup shows pfifo_fast backlog and tx_queue_len reached 1000 for a short period. Also a burst of retransmits on the next hop.

Sam: Hypothesis: batching change increased aggregated payloads -> more TCP segmentation / larger skbs -> kernel picks a slower path (GSO/GRO interplay) under heavy concurrency -> egress NIC/driver queuing + qdisc config (pfifo) causes tail latency. Plus conntrack pressure -> softlock contention.

Jess: Any immediate mitigation?

Teo: Short-term: revert kv-batching heuristic to previous cap (4), and change qdisc to fq on the NAT nodes to smooth bursts: `tc qdisc replace dev eth0 root fq`. Also increase conntrack max by 25% and enable nf_conntrack_tcp_be_liberal=1 for test.

Sam: Oncall runbook action: rolling rollback of kv-batch change to canary -> full. Rachel can you patch infra policy to flip qdisc?

Rachel: Will do. Pushing a quick change to infra-ansible now: set fq on nat-*-us-west2 and bump conntrack. Monitoring will be in place.

infra-bot: Deploy started for nat-us-west2 (playbook run id: pb-2026-03-18-09).

Teo: After rollback and fq change, early metrics show 99th back to ~130ms and tx_queue len normalized. Watch for side effects (small packet latency).

Sam: Filing follow-up: add a test for batching->egress interaction in perf harness (simulate aggregated batches + NAT queueing). Also add kernel selection tracepoint to our regression alerts (GRO/GSO fallback thresholds).

Jess: Good. Also let's add a note to private deployment docs: recommend fq or fq_codel on egress NATs for high-concurrency LLM traffic.

Sam: Thanks everyone. Will keep observing for 2h. If anything flares, ping @oncall-bot and escalate. :thumbsup:
